name: Text animation showcase — kinetic-center-build
description: Showcases the kinetic-center-build renderer family (ADR-0011). The title 'Built to flow' enters word-by-word from the right; each new word pushes prior words into their newly centered positions. Title-only by design — the layout-aware renderer reflows the line and assumes single-phrase content. Channel chrome notes: chrome-light to keep focus on the renderer verification; aesthetic-fit notes belong on a future syntax-mark-stroke-style brief.

content.title: Built to flow
content.body: The animation is layout-aware: each incoming word pushes the existing line so the full phrase ends balanced.
